newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Haven Funding AA long-term rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Haven Funding AA long-term rating.

text.p: LONDON, July 15 - IBCA, the European credit rating agency, is affirming the AA long-term rating of Haven Funding PLC, following the re-opening of this bond to permit the issuance of loans totalling GBP47.3m of additional stock.

The additional stock is being issued by virtue of Bromford Carinthia Housing Association ("BC") and Devon and Cornwall Housing Association ("DCHA") each becoming an additional borrower from the SPV, Haven Funding.

The structure of Haven has not changed as a result of there being additional borrowers. The income coverage tests have not changed, nor has the principle of a debt service reserve supporting the structure from a liquidity and credit perspective.
Both BC and DCHA are within the top 50 largest housing associations with c. 8,500 and 6,500 properties respectively under management. BC will charge properties to Haven for debt service purposes.

Headquartered in Wolverhampton, BC has a strong representation in the Midlands region. DCHA will charge units mainly located in the Plymouth, Devon and Cornwall region in which this housing association has a strong regional presence.
